key_points.point: Eshwarappa is a farmer in Chintamani, a town in Karnataka.
He visits the market regularly to buy seeds for his rice field.
During one such visit he overheard a conversation between Ramanna and Lakshmamma.
Ramanna said, “Earlier our country had about a lakh varieties of rice.
Farmers used to preserve different varieties of seeds and use them to grow rice.
Now, we only have a handful of varieties.
Also, farmers have to come to the market to buy seeds”.
Lakshmamma said, “There is a seed bank near my house.
